::: {#sol-noise-augment}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
noise_net = make_net()
noise_history, _ = fit(noise_net, transform=add_noise)
noise_best_val = noise_history["val"].min()
print(noise_best_val, best_val_loss)
```

`r if (py$noise_best_val < py$best_val_loss) "Yes" else "No"`.
The lowest validation loss with noise is `r sprintf("%.3f", py$noise_best_val)`,
against `r sprintf("%.3f", py$best_val_loss)` without it.
Noise added to the inputs is one of the regularizers *Deep Learning* discusses <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
[@goodfellow2016deep, section 7.5].

:::
